UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public profile and metadata for an authenticated Forge Operator user.

uid.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when account was first initialized.

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent user login.

UserReport.title: UserReport
UserReport.description: Saved Forge Operator AI operational triage report and execution plan.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this diagnostic report.

businessProblem.description: The operational problem statement input by the operator.

businessContext.description: Optional business context (team size, tech stack, constraints).

report.description: Full generated Forge Report containing prioritized actions, autonomous workflows, human gates, risks, and next steps.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document owned by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/reports/{reportId}.description: User's collection of saved Forge Operator triage reports and action plans.
